Hi there, and thanks so much for contacting Leafy! 🌿

Yes, we do offer buy-now-pay-later! It's available at checkout on orders between **$50 and $1,000**.

A couple of handy things to know:
- If you ever need a refund on an order paid this way, it goes to the instalment provider, who will adjust your remaining payments.
- Orders under $50 or over $1,000 aren't eligible for this option.

If you have any questions about your order or anything else, just let me know. Happy planting! 🪴
